create_docker_adapter: create a DockerAdapter instance to manage Docker containers via a thread-safe singleton
pull_docker_image: pull a Docker image from a registry by tag and return its image ID
run_docker_container: run a Docker container with specified image, args, env vars, network, ports, volumes, and GPU count
create_docker_network: create a Docker network by name and return its network ID
stop_docker_container: stop a running Docker container by its container ID
